column1: # flownet/tdesc/contract.tsv -- the TDESC algebra (canonical type descriptors of C declarators over int, e.g. P.A3.int
# for int (*x)[3]) as three finite nets; its consumer is tests/tdescprobe.cx (plans/m4-flownet-cx-module.md W3).
#   adj   may constructor OP hold HOLDS (C: no function returns an array or a function; no array holds functions)
#   ap    apply * (deref) or [ (index) to the type whose descriptor starts AT: its next position, the same, or not C
#   sz    the size of the type OP:INNER (OP holding a type of size INNER); int is 4, inc is incomplete (a function)
# Every key of every domain is one the derivation asks (W3 fix 3: no key outside the derivation, so a perturbation of
# any single answer must change the derivation's result or be refused -- FLOWNET_SWEEP, flownet/flow.cx).
